feature_definitions.close: completed current candle close, known at decision time
feature_definitions.realized_vol_{3,5,10}: sample standard deviation of trailing one-minute close returns, current return included
feature_definitions.volume_ratio_10: current volume divided by mean of prior 10 one-minute volumes; current excluded from baseline
feature_definitions.volume_zscore_10: current volume relative to prior 10 one-minute volumes; current excluded from baseline
feature_definitions.sma_ratio_{3,5,10}: current close / trailing SMA including current close - 1
feature_definitions.ema_ratio_{3,5,10}: current close / trailing EMA (adjust=false, current included) - 1
feature_definitions.rsi_7: 7-return rolling mean gains/losses, current return included; flat window maps to 50
feature_definitions.minutes_since_open: minute offset of candle open from official NYSE session open
feature_definitions.minutes_until_close: regular-session minutes after the candle open through final minute

causality: Features use only current completed OHLCV and trailing rows within a same-session continuous segment. Rolling state resets at session boundaries and every missing one-minute interval. No future values, labels, or target timestamps are model inputs.
missing_volume: The three volume-derived inputs may be NaN where source volume/baseline is unavailable; per-fold train-only median imputation handles those fields. Other feature warm-up fields must be present.
five_minute_feature_source: Original B feature order and live_app.features.calculate_b_features; reconstructed only from five complete consecutive IEX 1-minute candles.
